content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Let's compare the actual offerings of Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy with the infrastructure of a sovereign digital commerce stack, like Edge Commerce Stack ($197). While Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth, this still leaves a significant number of creators without access. In contrast, a sovereign stack offers a complete combination of free and paid tools that give any digital creator a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means creators can collect payments directly from customers, without relying on a third-party platform.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal's restrictions are notorious, and a single account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. In contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to operate independently of any payment processor, eliminating the risk of account suspension or termination. Furthermore, a sovereign stack can be set up to operate on a blockchain, allowing for secure and transparent payment processing, without the need for a centralized payment processor.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While Stripe and PayPal charge transaction fees, a sovereign digital commerce stack can operate with extremely low fees, often under $0.10 per transaction. This means creators can keep more of their hard-earned revenue, without sacrificing payment speed or reliability. Additionally, a sovereign stack can be set up to operate on a blockchain, allowing for faster payment processing and lower fees.
A sovereign digital commerce stack can operate on a blockchain, allowing for secure and transparent payment processing.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.

So, how do you sell digital products if Stripe is not available in your country? The answer is simple: build a sovereign digital commerce stack, like Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a complete combination of free and paid tools that give any digital creator a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
A sovereign digital commerce stack gives creators full ownership and control over their online store, products, and customer data.

If you're looking for an alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries, consider Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a complete combination of free and paid tools that give any digital creator a fully operational online store. You can also check out our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for a more comprehensive solution.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
